description: Diagnostic module to identify why 24 builds failed and 17 smoke tests failed simultaneously. Analyze the build log to find common failure patterns: shared import paths, similar file sizes, same dependency versions, identical build environment conditions. Query service_health for stale daemons (write_service 9h22m, self_diagnostics 23m, rug_pull_monitor 112h27m, wisdom_synthesiser 9h23m) and correlate with failure timestamps. Output a ranked list of likely root causes. This is a diagnostic-only file; do not propose rebuilds based on its output.
